this_title: The Birth of Need for Speed ProStreet
trans_title: 极品飞车: 街头狂飙的诞生
introduction: 回顾北美、日本和欧洲街头赛车运动的历史及其合法化进程，正是这些因素激发了《极品飞车：职业街头》的诞生。这部纪录片于 2007 年 11 月 10 日在 SPIKE TV 上播出一次后，曾在 Xbox Marketplace短暂上线。非常感谢 Le Mans Racer 与我们分享这部纪录片，他至今仍将这部纪录片保存在他的 360 上。A look at the history and legitimising street racing scene developing across North America, Japan, and Europe that inspired Need for Speed ProStreet.This documentary was made available for a short period of time via the Xbox Marketplace following a one-time showing on SPIKE TV on November 10, 2007.Big thanks to Le Mans Racer for sharing this with us, he still had this documentary saved in his 360.
